dialogues.speaker: Peyotli
dialogues.text: To be precise, it's a Wenut, not a dragon.

dialogues.speaker: Peyotli
dialogues.text: But some of the local schools of thought hold that Wenut are a form of dragon that have adapted to the desert environment, evolving, if you will, into what they are today.

dialogues.speaker: Peyotli
dialogues.text: While I disagree with their conjecture, I must admit that it's easy to see why they think this way.

dialogues.speaker: Peyotli
dialogues.text: Certain plants will present drastically different appearances depending on conditions such as temperature and light, but knowing what we do about the adaptability of dragons, surely they would undergo even more significant changes.
